product_one_liner.value: iVoyant provides enterprise integration and workflow-automation products alongside AI, cloud and application-engineering services to help businesses modernize their operations.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link was found in the site navigation/footer; the pricing URL did not yield a pricing page. Product pages mention subscriptions but do not publish plans; the government-services rate card is not a product pricing page.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering write-ups include Ayush Sharma’s May 13, 2025 account of the in-house PlatformNX copilot architecture and Carlos Gutierrez’s April 5, 2025 hands-on Firebase/AI application build; the latter is an experimental application, not a shipping commercial product.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes workflow, activity, API-management, administration and release-note articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live third-party listing for AI/ML Engineer in Bengaluru, marked posted four days ago. The official careers page lists a different subset of roles, so availability is supported by the job listing rather than the official board.

model_provider.notes: Koodisi documents activities that call the OpenAI REST API using the customer’s OpenAI account/API key; this establishes a supported provider, not the undisclosed backend provider of the embedded assistant.

compliance_certs.notes: Company announcement dated September 21, 2026 claims certification following a TÜV SÜD audit.

last_funding.notes: The funding database explicitly identifies iVoyant as unfunded with no funding rounds; its profile was last updated May 1, 2025. No later funding announcement was located.

raised_18mo.notes: No publicly known outside funding; the funding profile states no rounds. The profile predates the window, and no later raise was found, so this is not proof against undisclosed financing.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live third-party listings advertise a Bengaluru SDR role; it is not listed in the readable official careers-page subset.

launched_6mo.notes: October 2026 release introduced Agent Studio beta for building AI agents, agent-to-agent handoffs and MCP tools, plus chat-based workflow build/deploy/test capabilities; within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level/VP join or departure within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 was verified; the about page does not provide a complete named leadership roster with start dates.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR description explicitly assigns Apollo to lead data, LinkedIn/email to outreach and HubSpot to tracking; optional tools and customer-facing connectors are excluded.
